ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Startup Folder Persistence
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a file with a suspicious extension is created in the startup folder

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Start\\ Menu\\\\Programs\\\\Startup\\\\.*") AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.jar$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.msi$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.scr$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.cmd$")))
